hazards.control: The barricade line sits outside the whip and spray path of every pressurized line.

tabs.overview: Portable barricades at the pump row, the missile and the well row entries, set before pressure test and taken down after bleed-off. Signs on them name the hazard and the person who controls entry.
tabs.engineering: Red zone limits per the job's pressure plan; entry controlled by the frac supervisor.
tabs.safety: Nobody inside the red zone while iron is pressured except for a controlled entry; crossing a barricade is the stop-work everybody can call.
tabs.evidence: Pad photographs read for layout and proportion only (S9).

name: Barricades
function: Hard barricades that close the red zone around the high-pressure iron while it is pressured.
